result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For most small online stores, **Stripe is the best all-around payment processor**\. However, the best choice depends heavily on which ecommerce platform you use and how much you sell.

If you're starting a small online business, I'd narrow it down to these five.

## Best payment processors compared

![Expert Pricing – Tutora](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/s215eOkCrBJePJ6aedIAPORR2dSQKpg4r3kdjo_wlgJnHkyQ2l5DLHu9GE6cuq7DyIdsT5AkGFo_O1lteac7Hs-JP8Zcc66y70mgHCRBP4oIOblvA2wYsTXPnCEklYN9pAD0oC9n8Sn7qYbRw4Qg_jr4Bc3IEn5KMxhAijD_r0bRoq8DtkAmGOw6J64vSDi0?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

- Standard US online card rate: 2.9% + \$0.30
- No standard monthly processing fee
- Excellent fraud protection and reporting
- Integrates with WooCommerce, Wix, and many other platforms

Best for: Independent online stores that want flexibility.

[Stripe website](https://stripe.com)

---

![Shopify Payments w Polsce – jak działa, koszty, wdrożenie, zalety - Adtrip](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tzlxg0Y9z5dRoMa7puRQ5gUF-G3hcQ7FEcuVco38BEG917LKXepufVl9cw-FwTKDdqoHqkcHNs202c43Bsg-KXxlvnrYPNEJMBSIYJqLREQ2DlgIvAOQgkKyUCOU_zdRd59gIwC2e-5cs0YCLvv_6mYa-9FiK4qFkvvkawoheALPlNv3AkWQkvUMElw-UVk8?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Shopify Payments**

(Best for Shopify stores)

- Starting US online rate: 2.9% + \$0.30 on Basic
- Integrated directly into Shopify
- Simplifies refunds, orders, and payouts
- Avoids Shopify's additional third-party transaction fee

Best for: Stores already built on Shopify.

[Shopify Payments website](https://www.shopify.com/payments)

---

![Download the PayPal logo in PNG y SVG | LogosDown](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MAzkiJ1YuDnyj2FyYAyszlEHA_k7S0XqFuDRhbVDc0cICTj1-X82VJgt7N8vcRcKsONlo3HvF0Pe2MUizAJnEXGjXwhkQKSdT9w8dASkeKU2hONBc_K0UGh46cKL9ey1QEsmTJtnMOjwtp9k8flMfotUdye-2o09Vcb_X37Fr_RqbfMx2vNQ-Z2QRLli3zQI?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PayPal**

(Best for customer familiarity)

- Fees depend on checkout method
- Offers PayPal and eligible alternative payment options
- Familiar and trusted by many shoppers
- Easy to add to existing stores

Best for: Giving customers another way to pay.

[PayPal Business website](https://www.paypal.com/business)

---

![square-logo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/1usVU99QTc623Z1qK0LnerrVUCFuaCZRY9kzKFoWI_Gdr9NcpX1vWKOmILymiErxn6ndDcZZ0Or5-PjPVYj_lTK1K9NB9Q8Cck3TogeQjE13w7S0OC_soTbxUb84o9oqvCcpbffi8RgWQf3ncfxvUqtopiXbgd9lTiIMfcExXBRU8XgKgcPu-V2QhGDsZYzn?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Square**

- US online rates typically 3.3% + \$0.30 on its Free plan
- Easy setup
- Combines online and in-person payments
- Inventory and point-of-sale tools

Best for: Businesses selling online and at markets or physical locations.

[Square website](https://squareup.com/us/en)

---

![Top five fintech news stories of the week: 28 August 2026](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Nvwm5m0AvFIyEQCoAUiuiBYsES5Z_TGIIL3a7sg7Vv4eL9Itvfc5xa-EyPsr8IsSKHecG5NYexO0SMIejzwZMML07_ctHuEIL4ButxRVQGAmBUqOEkJLjZgpEozhbgzBigkUW3PNM8qwMbcubKNhZeml3Fh_1lYV5P7aYAnQGGfgg1x4XdQzyp-dffUe_NGw?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Helcim**

- Interchange-plus pricing
- No standard monthly fee
- Volume-based pricing advantages
- Useful as transaction volume increases

Best for: Growing stores looking to reduce processing costs.

[Helcim website](https://www.helcim.com)

US pricing examples; actual rates vary by plan, payment type, and eligibility. Sources: [www.nerdwallet.com](https://www.nerdwallet.com/business/software/learn/stripe-vs-paypal-vs-square?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.itechguides.com](https://www.itechguides.com/best-online-payment-solutions-for-businesses-2026-buyers-guide/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.shopify.com](https://www.shopify.com/blog/ecommerce-payment-gateway?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.techcognate.com](https://www.techcognate.com/best-payment-gateways-for-ecommerce/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

If I were opening a small online store today\:

- **Shopify store\:** Shopify Payments + PayPal.
- **WooCommerce store\:** Stripe + PayPal.
- **Custom-built website\:** Stripe.
- **Online and in-person sales\:** Square.

I wouldn't necessarily choose the processor with the lowest advertised fee. Reliability, checkout experience, fraud prevention, and customer payment preferences matter just as much.

I have three questions that will help me recommend the most cost-effective option.

**1\. What platform is your online store using?**
